items.headline: 1000x Perps Venue $PAPER Pays $10.3M in Hours
items.summary: Brand-new leverage venue Papertrade showed $10.3M in $PAPER staker rewards just hours after launch, with a $5M house pool and no queued payout debt. One of the hottest fresh token launches onchain right now.

items.headline: $AERO Rallies 48% in a Month Ahead of Merger
items.summary: $AERO is up 48% in four weeks, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether, as Aerodrome holds ~$393M TVL on Base. Its merger with Velodrome launches Oct. 21 with set token conversion terms.

items.headline: $STRK Eyed as StarkWare Backs Starknet L1 Shift
items.summary: StarkWare called a move to Layer 1 its 'clearest path forward' for Starknet, a major ecosystem pivot. $STRK traders are watching closely as the network still settles on Ethereum for now.

items.headline: $NEAR Jumps 83% in Four Weeks on Issuance Cut
items.summary: $NEAR gained 83% in four weeks, beating Bitcoin and Ether, as a draft plan would slash max annual issuance from 2.5% to 1.6%. Lower dilution is fueling the momentum.

items.headline: Coinbase Backs $ONED Stablecoin in Latin America
items.summary: Coinbase and Gennius plan to bring the $ONED stablecoin to Latin American banks, starting in Argentina. Users could convert deposits to $ONED, transfer 24/7 and spend via Visa.
